presumption_type: Affecting burden of producing evidence (disappears once opponent introduces contrary evidence; burden then shifts to proponent to prove accuracy by preponderance)

key_exceptions.1552_b: Computer-generated official records certified under §452.5 or §1530 are NOT governed by §1552; must use official records framework

citizen_relevance: Every electronic record in steward's cases — pension database printouts, emails, system logs, electronic medical records, screenshots of communications — is governed by §1552/1553. Attack strategy: challenge accuracy/reliability of opposing party's electronic records to rebut presumption and force proponent to prove accuracy by preponderance. Support own records: §1552/1553 admits steward's electronic evidence without full expert foundation unless challenged.
